message.content:
In Blackjack, an Ace can count as either **1** or **11**, whichever benefits the hand most.  
- If counting it as 11 keeps the hand’s total at 21 or below, it is treated as 11.  
- If counting it as 11 would cause the hand to bust (exceed 21), it is treated as 1.  

This flexible value allows Aces to help form a “natural” Blackjack (Ace + 10‑value card) or to avoid busting when the hand’s total is high.
